items: A blue, green, or purple dye
Raw cod (more if you burn cake)
A non-overgrown cat for catching rats
rec: Necklace of Passage for Wizards' Tower teleport
Feldip teleport. Fairy Ring (AKS), Gnome Glider
Karamja teleport. Brimhaven Teleport tablet, Fairy Ring (CKR)
enemies: Icefiend if you don't have Ice Gloves
If you need the greegrees still, a zombie, ninja, and guard monkey
rewards: Full access to the Culinaromancer's Chest

sec.n: Another Cook's Quest: Help the Cook

st.t: Talk to the Lumbridge Cook.
s: Do you have any other quests for me?
Angry! It makes me angry!
I don't really care to be honest.
What seems to be the problem?
YES

st.t: Use ashes on the fruit blast.
Talk to the Lumbridge Cook with the required items.
s: About those ingredients you wanted for the banquet...

st.t: Go through the door behind the Cook, in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen, to enter the dining room and watch the cutscene.
Inspect the dwarf in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.
Talk to Kaylee in the pub in Falador.
s: What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?
I could offer you some in return, how about 200 gold?

st.t: Add coins to asgarnian ale to make 4 asgoldian ale. You can buy ale from Kaylee for 3gp each.
Enter the tunnel under White Wolf Mountain.
Talk to the old dwarf, Rohak, in the tunnel. Keep talking to him until he's drunk on your 4 asgoldian ales and agrees to make the rock cake.
Talk to Rohak more, about 3 times, until he puts a dwarven rock cake on the table.
Pick up the dwarven rock cake. If you have ice gloves, wear them to pick it up. Otherwise, wear other gloves or telegrab it. If it despawns you'll need to bring Rohak more ingredients.
If you didn't pick up the rock cake with ice gloves, kill an icefiend on Ice Mountain to cool the rock cake.
Use the dwarven rock cake on the dwarf.
Inspect Wartface or Bentnoze in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.
Go talk to the Goblin Cook down the ladder in the Goblin Village.
s: I need your help...
What do you need? Maybe I can get it for you.

st.t: Give the Goblin Cook some charcoal.
s: I've got the charcoal you were after.

st.t: Talk to the Goblin Cook again.
s: I need your help...

st.t: Use a bucket of water on some bread.
Use a knife on an orange and SLICE it.
Use a dye on the sliced orange.
i: A blue, green, or purple dye

st.t: Use spices on the fishing bait.
Talk to the Goblin Cook again with the ingredients.
s: I've got the ingredients we need...

st.t: Use the slop on Wartface or Bentnoze.

i: A blue, green, or purple dye

st.t: Inspect Pirate Pete in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.
Talk to the Lumbridge Cook and ask him all the options about Pirate Pete.
s: Protecting the Pirate
Where do I get Ground Cod?
Where do I get Ground Kelp?
Where do I get Ground Giant Crab Meat?
Where do I get Breadcrumbs?

st.t: Talk to Murphy in Port Khazard.
s: Talk about Recipe for Disaster.

st.t: Talk to Murphy again.
s: Talk about Recipe for Disaster.

sec.n: Pirate Pete: Get Crab and Kelp

st.t: Wear the fishbowl helmet and diving apparatus, make sure you weigh less than 27 kg, and have at least 7 free inventory spaces. You can't go down with a pet. Then talk to Murphy again to go diving.
s: Talk about Recipe for Disaster.
Yes, Let's go diving.

st.t: Pick some kelp. Get 3 or so in case you burn a fishcake or two.
Talk to Nung in the north of the area.
Pick up 5 rocks in the west of the area.
Enter the underwater cave entrance.
Kill mudskippers for 5 hides.
Bring the hides to Nung.
Bring bronze wire and a needle to Nung.
Enter the crab pen and kill the crabs for some crab meat. Get 2-3 to be safe. You need 5 rocks for this: if you no longer have yours, pick up 5 more in the west of the area first.
Climb the anchor to the south to return to the surface.
Use a pestle and mortar on the crab.
Use a pestle and mortar on the kelp.
Use a pestle and mortar on a raw cod.
i: Raw cod (more if you burn cake)

st.t: Use a knife on some bread and make BREADCRUMBS.
Talk to the Lumbridge Cook about Pirate Pete again.
s: Protecting the Pirate

st.t: Use the ingredients together to make the cake.
Cook the fishcake. It's possible to burn it.
Give the fishcake to Pirate Pete to finish the quest. BE CAREFUL NOT TO EAT IT.

i: Raw cod (more if you burn cake)

st.t: Inspect the Lumbridge Guide in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.
s: Yes, I'm sure I can make a cake.

st.t: Go upstairs in the Wizards' Tower and talk to Traiborn.
s: Ask about helping the Lumbridge Guide.

st.t: Talk to Traiborn again to enchant the egg, and name the people he shows you. Ponytail and book: Reldo. Ghostly green woman: Velorina. Desert robes and white beard: Ali Morrisane. Elf: Islwyn. Purple shirt: Unferth. Brown vest: Observatory Professor Gronigen. Pink top: Gertrude. Green witch: Hetty. Hooded man: Pirate Pete. Crown: King Lathas.
s: Ask about helping the Lumbridge Guide.
Okay. Let's start!

st.t: Talk to Traiborn again to enchant the milk, and answer his questions. Defence to wear a Mystic hat: 20. Ingredients in a cake: Flour, Eggs and milk. Combat level of goblins near Lumbridge: 2. Coins to bribe an Al Kharid gate guard: 10. Not between Morytania and Asgarnia: Keep Le Faye. Gold ring is to 5 as a holy symbol is to: 16. Glass vial is to 33 as a glass orb is to: 46. Guild closest to the Fishing Platform: Legends'. Bar west of Pollnivneach: Bandit camp. The River Salve runs: North to South. Howling one way and buzzing the other: Catherby. To make glass you first need: Sand, bucket, soda ash, glass blowing pipe. Tower closest to the Crafting Guild: Dark Wizards'. The sum using Fire Strike, Wind Strike and Earth Wave runes: 10.
s: Ask about helping the Lumbridge Guide.
Okay. I'm ready!

st.t: Talk to Traiborn again to enchant the flour. Close the window of items with its X button, then answer. Item beginning with M: Mind Talisman. Item not shown: Trout. How many weapons: Three. How many types of rune: Two. Items you were shown: Guthix Prayer Book, Magic Logs, Pike.
s: Ask about helping the Lumbridge Guide.
Quiz me!

st.t: Talk to Traiborn for the enchanted ingredients, then mix them in a tin.
Cook the Guidance Cake.
Use the Guidance Cake on the Lumbridge Guide to finish the quest.
Inspect Evil Dave in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.
Enter Doris's basement in Edgeville.
Talk to Evil Dave.
s: What did you eat at the secret council meeting?
You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!

st.t: Go up to Doris.
Talk to Doris.
Go back down to Evil Dave with your cat and about 10 stews.
Have your cat catch Hell-Rats in the basement: long-press the cat and choose Chase. They give red, orange, yellow and brown spices. Collect at least 3 of each colour.

Find the right amount of each colour, which is 1, 2 or 3 and differs per player. Add 1 of a colour to a stew and use the stew on Evil Dave. If he says you've got the amount of one spice right, note it down. If not, try 2 of that colour; if 2 is wrong as well, the answer is 3. Let him finish talking each time. If you add too much of a spice, eat the stew and start again.
Add the right amount of all four colours to one stew and use it on Evil Dave in the basement.
Use the spicy stew on Evil Dave in the Lumbridge Castle dining room to finish.

i: A non-overgrown cat for catching rats

st.t: Inspect Awowogei in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.
Wearing a greegree and your M'speak amulet, talk to Awowogei on Ape Atoll, south of the temple.
Talk to any one of the three monkeys sitting in the north-west corner of the temple.
s: Do you know anything about the King's favourite dish?

st.t: Use a banana on any of the three monkeys.
Use some monkey nuts on any of the three monkeys.
Talk to Lumdo at the landing area on the south coast of Ape Atoll and travel to Crash Island.
Enter the hole on Crash Island. Protect melee when entering as you'll be attacked straight away by snakes.
s: Yes, I'm as hard as nails.

st.t: Kill a Big Snake for its corpse. Kill a few in case you burn it.
Leave the hole.
Travel back to Ape Atoll with Lumdo.
Use a rope on the red banana tree on the north west of Ape Atoll as a gorilla.
Equip your ninja greegree and start the Ape Atoll Agility Course. After swinging on the rope, go down the hole.
Take a nut from the bush. Take a few in case you burn the final meal.
Use a pestle and mortar on the tchiki nuts.
Use a knife/slash weapon on the red banana.
Use the tchiki nut paste and the sliced red banana on the snake corpse to stuff it.
Enter the trapdoor in the monkey temple.
Go down one of the ramps and enter the crack in the wall between the two ramps.
Go across the hot rocks with the zombie greegree equipped. Cook the stuffed snake on the rock at the end of the room.
Give the snake to Awowogei to finish the quest.
Inspect Sir Amik Varze in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.
Talk to the Lumbridge Cook and ask him all the options about Sir Amik Varze.
s: More...
Protecting Sir Amik Varze

st.t: Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village (an amulet of glory teleports you there) about strange beasts and the Evil Chicken. Finish the whole chat, or you can't go on.
s: I'd just like to ask you something.
Strange beasts
The Evil Chicken

sec.n: Sir Amik Varze: Get token and egg

st.t: Travel to Zanaris.
Use a raw chicken on the Chicken Shrine in the north east of Zanaris.
The shrine takes you to the Evil Chicken's lair. Run north past the black dragons and kill the Evil Chicken. Pray Protect from Magic against it.
Pick up the evil chicken egg.
Kill a black dragon.
Pick up the dragon token.

sec.n: Sir Amik Varze: Making the brulee

st.t: Use a bucket of milk on a pot of cream.
Use cornflour on the milky mixture.
Add a vanilla pod to the cornflour mixture.
Use the evil chickens egg on the brulee.
Use a pestle and mortar on the dramen branch.
Use the cinnamon on the brulee.
If you're still in the Evil Chicken's lair, leave through the portal in the south to return to Zanaris.
In Zanaris or Lumbridge, equip your Ice Gloves and rub the dragon token. Ask the fairy dragon to cook your brulee.
s: Please flambe this creme brulee for me.

st.t: Give the Brulee to Sir Amik Varze to finish the quest.
Inspect Skrach Uglogwee in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.
s: Yes, I'm sure I can get some Jubbly Chompy.
Oh Ok then, I guess I'll talk to Rantz.

st.t: Talk to Rantz in Feldip Hills.
s: I'm trying to free Skrach, can you help?
Ok, I'll do it.

st.t: Talk to Rantz on the east coast of Feldip Hills.
s: Ok, here I am...I guess this is the watery place? What now?

st.t: Use an axe on the old tree near Rantz.
Use an axe on the old tree near Rantz again.
Talk to Rantz again on the east coast of Feldip Hills.
s: Ok, the boat's ready, now tell me how to get a Jubbly?

st.t: Use an iron spit on a chompy.

Go to Karamja's west coast, just south of the transportation icon west of Tai Bwo Wannai (fairy ring CKR, then run north along the coast). Find the small tree with an arrow in it. Light a fire right next to that tree, then use your skewered chompy on the fire.
Travel back with Rantz's kids and talk to Rantz again.
s: Yes please, I'll get a lift back with you.
Ok, now tell me how to get Jubbly!

tr: Feldip teleport. Fairy Ring (AKS), Gnome Glider
Karamja teleport. Brimhaven Teleport tablet, Fairy Ring (CKR)

st.t: Fill your ogre bellows at the swamp bubbles a short walk east of the Feldip Hills fairy ring, then use them on a toad nearby to blow it up. Keep at least 1 charge in the bellows for later.
Mine a pile of rocks near the Feldip Hills Fairy Ring for a rock.
Use the bellows on your toad with a ball of wool in your inventory.
Drop the balloon toad in the dark area south of Rantz's cave and wait for a Jubbly to arrive.
Kill then pluck jubbly.
Pluck the jubbly's carcass.
Pick up the raw jubbly.
Cook the raw jubbly on Rantz's spit.
Give the jubbly to Skrach Uglogwee to finish the quest.

Enter the portal in Lumbridge Castle, ready to fight. You can leave between fights to re-gear. Have your ice gloves pre-equipped for the second fight against Flambeed to avoid them making you drop your weapon on the floor.
Kill Agrith-Na-Na. He uses magic at ranged, and melee up close.
Equip ice gloves and kill Flambeed. Water spells are especially effective. FLAMBEED WILL MAKE YOU DROP YOUR WEAPON ON THE FLOOR if you do not have ice gloves on and have a full inventory.
Kill Karamel. Stand in melee distance, and bring restore potions, as she drains your stats. Fire spells are especially effective.
Kill Dessourt.
Kill the Gelatinnoth mother. You'll need to use air spells when she's white, earth when brown, fire when red and water when blue, melee when orange and ranged when green.
Kill the Culinaromancer. Try to keep your distance.
